answer_1.quote: The Goal-oriented Proactive Dialogue System (GPDS) focuses on achieving specific objectives by actively guiding and anticipating user needs... GPDS can be divided into two primary sub-tasks: goal-oriented path planning and response generation.

answer_2.quote: Evaluation Metrics We follow previous work and use the following metrics: Word-level F 1 (W F 1 ), BLEU, Distinct (Dist), Knowledge F 1 (K F 1 ), and Goal Success Rate (Succ).

answer_3.quote: we utilize ChatGPT to act as an annotator for the annotations of inconsistency types and correction suggestions. We feed the dialogue context and the generated response to ChatGPT and let it evaluate the consistencies.
methods: evaluate consistency and provide inconsistency types and correction suggestions

answer_4.quote: We conducted a pairwise human evaluation to compare the models with (w/) and without (w/o) CRC... We randomly selected 500 pairs of system responses from the DuRecDial dataset... invited three NLP graduate students to independently evaluate them.
answer_4.guideline: The evaluators are asked to assign one of three possible labels (i.e., 'win', 'tie', or 'lose') to two anonymous responses... Specific guidelines of the manual evaluation are as follows: Consistency with User Profile... Consistency with Dialogue History... Consistency with Domain Knowledge... Consistency with Subgoals...
